title: Setup → metadata edit page saves a bad name anyway and stacks three messages (server refusal, client summary, inline error) (#27521 row 16)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 16 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator creating a permission set (and any metadata item edited on the same page). What happens: with an illegal name the save is sent anyway, and the page then draws the server refusal ("is not a legal metadata item name"), the client summary ("does not match the spec — 1 validation error(s)") and the inline field error — three messages for one mistake. Reach: every administrator creating a set.

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`: the client validator flags the name, but the save is not held, so the server refusal and the summary banner are drawn beside the inline error.
- The spec half (Label first + required) is the sibling card #27864, split from the same row.

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

While the client validator refuses, the save is held and only the inline error is shown.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A bad name on New Permission Set: Save sends no request and only the inline error is shown.
- [ ] A name the client accepts but the server refuses shows one message.
- [ ] A test pins that no save request leaves while the client validator refuses.

Refs #27521
